title: The first run of fall
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The tech runs the fall's first digest. The machine's been to Corvallis again over summer. It runs blacker. The tech says they cleaned the drum. Wood says the strip looks like it means it. The tech says it always did; the drum didn't.

panels.composition: The print shop, fall. Students in the hall. The TECH at the machine. WOOD. BARNABY on the counter.

image.prompt: a busy college print shop with students in the hall outside, a technician at a large copier, a young man and a small dog at the counter, black and white, no words

panels.composition: A copy coming out: blacker than before, the line hard, the spotting solid.

image.prompt: close on a fresh photocopy of a comic strip with hard black lines and solid spotting, black and white, no words

balloons.text: It looks like it means it.

image.prompt: a print technician holding up a crisp copy, dry, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The cover: the digest's own first page, drawn — the strip in the machine, black. Wood taking the stack. The fall's first forty. Warm.

image.prompt: a young man taking a warm stack of small booklets from a print shop counter, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'It always did. Drum didn't.' The fall's line: blacker.
